title.zh: Apple Unveils Redesigned Siri AI and A20 Pro Chip as CEO John Ternus Makes Debut
title.en: Apple Unveils Redesigned Siri AI and A20 Pro Chip as CEO John Ternus Makes Debut

current_state.zh: Apple unveils redesigned Siri AI powered by Google's Gemini, A20 Pro chip on TSMC 2nm process, and first foldable iPhone at 'Surprise and Shine' event led by new CEO John Ternus.
current_state.en: Apple unveils redesigned Siri AI powered by Google's Gemini, A20 Pro chip on TSMC 2nm process, and first foldable iPhone at 'Surprise and Shine' event led by new CEO John Ternus.
